introduction Having gained extensive knowledge of the island's wondrous  creatures, you can now harness the mystical abilities of your  crew creatures to further assist your exploration! Combine the various abilities of the Crews and Captains to  create new strategies. You can now recruit even more diverse  and mysterious creatures to your Crew! 

A copy of Wondrous Creatures is needed to play this  Expansion. components 9 Crew Cards 15 Crew Members  1 magnetic and 2 regular meeples per color 4

Proceed with the preparation of the Base Game (see  pages 4-6 of the Base Game rulebook), with the  following exceptions: ·   Variant Rule A : For players seeking a more competitive       experience, acquire the Captain Board, Creature Cards,      and Crew Cards simultaneously, and choose the     combination of the three you want to use. This way, you     can consider all variables at once! ·   Variant Rule B : If you'd rather use your favorite Meeples,    starting from the last player, in reverse order, choose the     Crew Meeples to use and take the corresponding Crew Card.              Occasionally, confusion may arise during the  game when multiple players opt for Crew members in  identical colors. To avoid this, players have the option to  use a Crew of a different color, even if they don't exactly  match the chosen Crew Card. game setup 1 13 r ·   When proceeding with step        -        of the Base Game      setup, players do not take their player-colored Crew      members. ·   Instead, draw 2 random Crew Cards , choose one, and      take 3 matching Crew members of the selected Crew Card. START OF GAME Use this ability after game  setup but before the 1st  player starts their turn.  ·   Crew Cards are single-use  cards that have the potential to      significantly enhance your gameplay when their abilities      are strategically used at opportune moments. ·   Crew Cards can only be used once per game and cannot be     reactivated under any circumstances. After using the Crew      Card's ability, the card is flipped face-down.  ·   Should there be specific conditions for utilizing their      abilities, these conditions must be met first. ·   Using the ability of a Crew Card is a Free Action  and does     not consume an Action. ·   The abilities of Crew Cards are divided into 2 categories. ·   Crew Cards are not Creature Cards and do not fit into any      specific classification of Creature Cards (Instant Card,      Continuous Card, Recharge Card, Energy Card, End Card). Albuserpent : Once per game, immediately complete an  Achievement whose condition has been met, gain the  Achievement Marker Reward and a Trophy. Achievements with  conditions that have not been met cannot be completed. Each  Achievement Slot can only accommodate one Achievement  Marker, so you cannot place your marker on a slot already  occupied by another player's marker. An Achievement  completed in this way is part of the effect of Albuserpent and  does not consume an Action. 2. Luteusaurs : Once per game, choose 1 Energy Card from  your reserve and restore its Energy to its full Energy Limit.  This effect only applies to Energy Cards, so it cannot restore  the Captain Board's Energy. 3. Armoruber : Once per game, gain 1 resource of choice. For  each revealed Time Token, gain an additional resource of  choice. E.g., if there are currently 4 revealed Time Tokens, you  can gain a total of 5 resources. These resources can be of the  same type or a mix of different types. 4. Skaelruleus : At the start of the game, choose 2 cards from  the Wilderness and add them to your hand, beginning the  game with a total of 6 Creature Cards in your hand instead of  4. After taking the cards, draw 2 new cards from the deck to refill the Wilderness. appendix 11

Felila : At the start of the game, immediately gain 2 VPs and  shuffle the remaining unchosen Crew Cards. Draw one  randomly, discard the resources indicated on the drawn Crew  Card, and replace Felila with the newly drawn card for this  game.
